branchName.instructions: Conventional type prefix: feat/, fix/, chore/, docs/, refactor/, test/, then a short kebab-case summary using glossary words (docs/glossary.md).

commitMessage.instructions: Conventional Commits with a domain scope, e.g. feat(field-ops): … or fix(ingestion): …. Imperative subject. Always end with the trailer: Co-Authored-By: m0hss <dev.fixbyte@proton.me>

pullRequest.instructions: Lead with a one-paragraph summary, then a Test plan section. Use 'Refs #n' (not 'Closes #n') for hitl stories. If the field route changed, paste the check:precache line that pnpm build prints.
